name: Absorption product native work saved physical state resumes without duplicate deal

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local id='native-product-return-probe'
local before=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[id])
assert(before.Status=='WAITING_UI','saved product state was not waiting')
local external
for _,work in ipairs(before.NativeWorks or {}) do if work.Custodian then external=work;break end end
assert(external and external.PhysicalMoved and external.TargetSlot,'saved work physical proof absent')
local tx=A.Resume(id)
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(external.Source.Index)
assert(#found==1,'resumed product work index missing or duplicated')
local w=found[1];local slot=external.TargetSlot
assert(w.Owner==slot.Owner and w.CityID==slot.City and w.X==slot.X and w.Y==slot.Y and w.Building==slot.Building and w.Slot==slot.Slot,'resumed product work left reserved slot')
local source=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(external.Source.X,external.Source.Y))
local assets=A.CityAssets(source)
assert(assets[external.Source.BuildingType].Works[external.Source.Slot]==-1,'resumed product original source slot reused')
local transferred=0
for _,city in ipairs(tx.Cities or {}) do local current=CityManager.GetCityAt(city.X,city.Y);if current and current:GetOwner()==tx.To then transferred=transferred+1 end end
print('[JAC_NATIVE_PRODUCT_LOADED_RESUME] status='..tx.Status..' sourceOwner='..source:GetOwner()..' transferred='..transferred..'/'..#tx.Cities..' finalUI='..tostring(tx.AwaitingFinalUI)..' index='..w.Index)
if tx.Status=='COMPLETE' then assert(A.Verify(id,false),'completed product verification failed') end
return 'saved product state resumed to '..tx.Status
